preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The list p contains exactly n-1 integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= pi <= i for i, pi in enumerate(p))
preconditions.description: Each pi in p satisfies 0 ≤ pi ≤ i.
The list x contains exactly n integers.

preconditions.expression: all(xi in {0, 1} for xi in x)
preconditions.description: Each xi in x is either 0 or 1.
There is at least one black vertex (xi == 1).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer less than 1,000,000,007.
The output is the number of ways to split the tree such that each resulting part has exactly one black vertex, modulo 1,000,000,007.
